unresolvedConflicts.subject: Caturus mixed upstream/LNG platform boundary
unresolvedConflicts.issue: Caturus combines upstream natural gas production with LNG export infrastructure, creating ambiguity over whether the full platform or only its infrastructure components should be counted.
unresolvedConflicts.recommendedResolution: Include the full platform but explicitly disclose mixed upstream and infrastructure exposure without separately counting Commonwealth LNG.
